description: Реальный ВВП еврозоны-21 (цепные объёмы 2020 г., SA)
methodology: Million euro, chain-linked volumes (reference year 2020), seasonally and calendar adjusted, euro area 21 (fixed composition as of 2026-01-01), from 1995-Q1. Until 2026-11-28 this was the euro area 20 series (I9, reference year 2015), which the ECB ended at 2026-Q1; the level of every quarter changed with the switch (0.2-1.1 % higher), growth rates by under 0.1 pt.
